Class RMINetworkManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.NetworkManager
it.polimi.ingsw.network.RMINetworkManager
public class RMINetworkManager extends NetworkManager
Handles client-side network operations using Java RMI (Remote Method Invocation). It extends NetworkManager to forward user interactions directly to the server stub or the remote controller via RMI remote procedure calls, and manages an automatic heartbeat mechanism to detect server disconnections.
